notes: Write budgets are conservative development reservations, not measured production requirements or capacity claims.
Recheck free space and projected download/extraction size immediately before every provisioning batch.
Existing toolchains may be reused read-only only after exact hash/version/provenance review; do not duplicate automatically.
No cache, build output, donor storage or database is authorized for deletion.
Full RR, soak, retention and off-host restore budgets require S16/S17 measured growth; this budget does not authorize those workloads.
